patterns.note: Full-width sections alternate between dark blue and light purple/white backgrounds to delineate content blocks.
Content sections frequently employ a two-column structure, pairing descriptive text on one side with abstract 3D graphics or imagery on the other.
Major section headings are rendered in very large, bold, uppercase sans-serif typography, creating a strong visual hierarchy.
A dominant dark blue (#1C254A) is consistently contrasted with vibrant light purple (#E0D0F0) and medium purple (#7B68EE) accents, alongside white text for readability.
A persistent 'GET STARTED' call-to-action button remains fixed in the bottom-left corner of the viewport, visible throughout the entire scroll experience.
Feature sections are introduced with large, numbered headings and a concise description, often accompanied by a corresponding visual graphic or image.

technique_notes: A fixed-position element is used for a persistent call-to-action button, ensuring it remains visible in the bottom-left corner of the screen regardless of scroll depth.
Sections are visually separated by alternating background colors, creating clear content blocks and guiding the user's eye down the page.
Large, bold, uppercase sans-serif typography is used for primary headings to establish a strong visual hierarchy and impact.

design_tokens.type_scale: Very large, bold, uppercase headings (~4-5x body text) with a clean, legible sans-serif for body copy.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners are dominant across most elements, with subtle rounding applied to interactive components like buttons.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, characterized by generous vertical padding between major sections and within the hero area.

standout: The site's distinctive use of abstract, often glowing, 3D geometric and human-like figures as visual metaphors, combined with a bold, high-contrast dark blue and purple color scheme, creates a futuristic and authoritative aesthetic that feels unique and memorable.
